model.title: Holocaust Education and Antisemitism Lessons Act
model.meta: Energy and Natural Resources Committee · Sen. Jacklyn Rosen (D-NV)

summary.text: The bill would direct the U.S. Holocaust Memorial Museum to study how states and local school districts teach about the Holocaust in public schools. The study would examine whether Holocaust education is required, what educational standards are in place, and what teaching materials schools use.
